name: smwsprites-non-line-guided-mario-following-grinder
title: Non line guided, Mario following Grinder
description:
This is a non-line guided grinder who doesn't dumbly go forward, but chases Mario and tries to kill him.
Based on a dissasembly by Nesquik Bunny.
Please give credit to both me and him.

NOTE: Put a message box, explaining that the sprite follows Mario.
And try not to make 2 of them appear at the same place, since they will "blend" in each other, while going in the same direction.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

Mathos's note: fixed bugs and added a frequency adjusting define (to change how often the sprite retries to face Mario), so give credit too pls
